newsitem.title: JAPAN: Govt agencies had Y2 trln NCB bonds in Dec-sources.
newsitem.headline: Govt agencies had Y2 trln NCB bonds in Dec-sources.

text.p: Government agencies held a total of 2.07 trillion yen worth of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's (NCB) bank debentures as of the end of last year, parliamentary sources said on Thursday.

As of the end of December, holdings of the Ministry of Finance's (MOF) Trust Fund Bureau in NCB bank debentures totalled 1.41 trillion yen, while those of the Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo) amounted to 537.2 billion yen.
The Postal Savings System (Yucho) held 11.3 billion yen worth, and the Pension Welfare Service Public Corp's holdings amounted to 110.3 billion yen.

The MOF Trust Fund Bureau's funds totalled 388.38 trillion yen as of the end of December. The bureau invests part of its funds in bank debentures, and its total holdings in bank debentures are announced on a monthly basis. The bureau does not release a breakdown of its bank debenture holdings.
Specifics regarding Kampo, Yucho and the Pension Welfare Service Public Corp's holdings were also not released.
The breakdown of bank debenture holdings was compiled by the government at the request of the Lower House budget committee.
Officials at the respective government agencies all refused comment on the breakdown figures.
